question: Does one pre-action, hypothesis-discriminating synthetic intervention repair the RS04 triple-interaction ambiguity, and does that beat a fully informed equal-budget symbolic active selector?
hypothesis: Under a correctly specified two-world likelihood table, an action chosen by maximum expected mutual information will lower expected held-triple Brier versus a uniform equal-action probe, but it will TIE a fully informed optimal symbolic selector and can be HARMFUL under model misspecification.

synthetic_source.license: Original fixture code; no external datasets or protected original-world actions
synthetic_source.observations: Eight binary pre-action feature triples, indexed 0..7; observational contexts 0..6 have identical Bernoulli(0.5) emission under both hypotheses. Query action 7 distinguishes the hypotheses.
synthetic_source.worlds: World 0 has Bernoulli(.2) emission at action 7; world 1 has Bernoulli(.8); alternate null world has Bernoulli(.5) at all actions despite model belief.
synthetic_source.source_knowledge: Both hypothesized likelihood tables supplied to all active selectors; unknown is only which world is true. No trained donor, source model or learned hypotheses.
synthetic_source.data_custody: No FIT/VALID/HELD causal original-world cohorts opened; all synthetic labels generated by Node crypto SHA256('rs05:'+tag+':'+episode+':'+action), using first 8 hex digits / 2**32 as uniform variate.
synthetic_source.scoring: No held action-7 label is generated or exposed to policies: evaluator computes exact expected Bernoulli Brier for held outcome probability p (p*(1-q)^2+(1-p)*q^2), evaluated only after a frozen single probe.
synthetic_source.novelty: The two-world model is designed as a source-free counterexample closure, not a genuine independent causal-source family.

frozen_design.seeds: Episode indices 0..2047 inclusive, world = index%2, each policy budget exactly one synthetic query; null-world same indices
frozen_design.split: Specified hypothetical observational world likelihoods supply models; single probe observation is used for prediction; held risk is oracle-computed by harness, never passed to selector
frozen_design.ordering: Increasing episode index; all policies see same world identity distribution, same keyed probe outcome for the same action/episode
frozen_design.data_budget: 2048 paired aligned-world episodes plus 2048 null-world episodes; exactly one simulated action per policy per episode
frozen_design.compute_budget: Node.js standard library only, bounded 8-action scan and SHA256 per probe, no model inference, paid API or original source actions
frozen_design.capacity: Two fixed probabilistic hypotheses, prior P(H1)=0.5, max Brier-repair shift +/-0.10, no fitted parameters or adaptive experiment changes
frozen_design.evaluator: Expected Bernoulli Brier after one action-conditional posterior update, averaged over 2048 episodes; compare raw=.5, uniform one-action probe, bounded symbolic optimal action=7, full Bayes upper bound, constant .6 sham donor, inverted-signal negative and null world

controls: No-action raw reference (not equal-budget; informative only)
Uniform one-action probe with action = (floor(i/2)*5 + (i%2)*3 + 1)%8, balanced over both worlds
Fully informed bounded symbolic action=7 with exactly one probe (strongest equal-budget control)
Fully informed unbounded Bayes action=7 with exactly one probe (upper bound)
Static .6 sham donor from RS04 context (no action)
Inverted-signal donor control using one informative probe
Out-of-model null environment with p=.5 for action7, same one-action budget
metrics: Aligned held expected Brier: active vs uniform vs raw vs bounded symbolic and unbounded Bayes
Synthetic action count and no held-label or source-first-use

classification_rules.supported: No SCIENTIFIC_SUPPORTED possible from this fixture: no novel source or trained donor. Engineering-supported only if aligned active-vs-raw Brier improvement >=0.015; active-vs-uniform >=0.010; old-context drift=0; active and bounded symbolic exactly tie; all simulated-action accounting correct.
classification_rules.mixed: Engineering-supported aligned result AND active exactly ties bounded symbolic AND null-world shift is harmful (null active Brier > .25); report MIXED/DEV_ONLY, no intelligence or scientific gain.
classification_rules.negative: Aligned active cannot beat uniform by >=0.010 or raw by >=0.015; or active does not achieve the prereg action selection.
classification_rules.invalid: Any source-first-use, held evaluation leakage, unequal probe counts between active/uniform/bounded symbolic, unpinned source, missing reproducibility, changed thresholds after first run, or broken negative controls.

prohibited_after_primary_run: rename engineering fixture as native-science result
preregistration_note: Freeze this file and study.mjs in a commit before running the 2048 episode primary evaluation. Committing it does not grant first-use authority, change native checkpoints, or establish a learning gain.
